cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'

mechanism: A keeps its former discussion pupil engaged until a taught shared closing response is performed, adapting the ritual to the pupil departing taxi.
confusable: Not indefinite company or a one-sided goodbye: both speakers must supply specified closing words, and A accommodates location to obtain them.
comparison: Shared club response around taxi urgency versus ending employment through a joint bell.
seedUse: D170 book club/chapter closed/until next time/taxi; S05 old spoken-response coaching.
